svg.title: At equal size random edits reached 44.1% of removal, 5.1% of induction
svg.desc: Heatmap. 1. First swap test, 30 Oct, size not measured: Toward the rival, bee-helper 17.3%, Toward the rival, crow-helper 1.1%, Away from the rival, bee-helper 13.4%, Away from the rival, crow-helper 1.2%; 2. Free replies, 30 Oct, 0.17 times the size: Toward the rival, bee-helper 18.7%, Toward the rival, crow-helper 6.6%, Away from the rival, bee-helper 14.0%, Away from the rival, crow-helper 12.3%; 3. Sustained random edits, 30 Oct, 1.79 times the size: Toward the rival, bee-helper 14.2%, Toward the rival, crow-helper 20.6%, Away from the rival, bee-helper 57.8%, Away from the rival, crow-helper 65.7%; 4. Removal only, 31 Oct, 1.0 times the size: Toward the rival, bee-helper no value, Toward the rival, crow-helper no value, Away from the rival, bee-helper 18.9%, Away from the rival, crow-helper 35.2%; 5. 61 new scenarios, 31 Oct, 1.0 times the size: Toward the rival, bee-helper 3.5%, Toward the rival, crow-helper 5.1%, Away from the rival, bee-helper 44.1%, Away from the rival, crow-helper 37.2%.
